name: CAN bus short - every module goes silent
description: CAN-H shorted to CAN-L: not a single frame gets through. The engine keeps running, but the cluster falls back to fail-safe lamps, the TCM goes into limp mode and the scan tool gets no answer. After the repair every module tells the story with U-codes - and one knock-on DTC keeps the MIL on.

steps.note: Waiting for the cluster bulb check to finish
A chafed harness shorts CAN-H to CAN-L
1. The cluster lights MIL, ABS and TRANS because their senders are silent
2. The scan tool cannot reach anything - check the bus wiring before blaming a module
3. Frames flow again - and the engine ran the whole time
TRANS and ABS lamps go out: their messages are back
But the MIL stays on. Network DTCs request no lamp - so who does?
A knock-on fault: without ABS_Status the TCM lost its vehicle speed (P0500)
... and asked the ECM for the MIL (P0700)
4. Everybody missed everybody: the U-code pattern points at the bus, not at one node
5. One functional request clears every module
